description: Broker send tickets. The broker looks the presented ticket's id (`computed.presentedId`) up among the tickets it minted and hasn't burned: `ticket` is the one it found, or null. `request.ticket` is what the plugin presented, from channel_send's _meta["io.github.draftyak/send-ticket"] through host/fetch's sendTicket, absent when it presented none; `request.contentType` is the Content-Type the plugin gave, `request.headers` the hub-rendered headers the broker sends and `request.bodyHex` the exact body; `now` is the broker's clock in UTC ms. `reason` names the first of `checks` that fails, or is null: a ticket was found; it is a SendTicket and now a safe integer; the presented ticket is JCS-equal to it; now <= exp; instanceId, method, url and contentType equal byte for byte; headersSha256 equals headersSha256(request.headers), and those headers hold exactly one content-type, equal to the ticket's; bodySha256 equals the SHA-256 of the body. The broker burns every ticket it found, and the reasons in `disablesPlugin` also disable the plugin. `expiry` gives exp: the earlier of mintedAt + ttlMs and the item's deliverBy.
